Lesson 1 · Business route

Build evidence you can trust

Which lodging offer can we recommend with confidence?

Fictional case. The observations are generated for teaching, not evidence about a real business. The full data-generating process is in the technical appendix.

What the data show

The fictional file starts with 61 offer rows. After checking the key, defining the relevant market and removing incomplete scoped records, 37 comparable offers remain.

What would you decide?

Compare the full two-night cost for offers that meet the same requirements. Record every exclusion before ranking. A cheaper row is not automatically a better or even a valid offer.

Pause and explain

If a join creates more rows than either source table, should the manager trust the resulting ranking?

Compare your reasoning

No. Check the join keys and row counts first. Duplicate matches can change prices, weights and rankings.

What the generator knows

Reveal the known truth after making your judgment

The generator deliberately includes one duplicate and three incomplete records in the selected market. Those are known teaching facts, not discoveries about real hotels.

The truth belongs to this invented model. A real organization would still need to test the assumptions and collect its own evidence.

Read the guided lesson

The guided lesson follows this business decision through the practical problem, evidence and next action. The technical appendix has the generation rules, derivations and all 18 original teaching stops.
